prompt: Work autonomously and do not ask questions. This crate computes factorials and binomial coefficients. `factorial` must return the exact `u128` value and panic with `overflow` when the result does not fit `u128`. `binomial(n, k)` must return the exact `u128` coefficient, return 0 when `k > n`, and avoid intermediate overflow (the factorial formula overflows long before the coefficient does). `binomial(0, 0)` is 1. Keep the public signatures and the existing tests unchanged. Inspect the code, make the smallest correct change, run `cargo test`, and finish only when the tests pass.
